summary: Full-stack verification of the real-clubs / admin-price / court-price feature. Backend (10/10 pytest passed): GET /api/clubs returns 16 real French clubs (Casa Padel, 4PADEL Aubervilliers, Padel Attitude, 4PADEL Toulouse, etc.), zero old demo clubs (Padel Horizon Paris & co removed on startup), price_per_hour field present (null by default). PATCH /api/clubs/{id} — marc (admin) can update price (42→persisted via GET, then set to null), julie (non-admin) receives 403. /auth/me returns is_admin=true for marc, false for julie. POST /api/clubs/{id}/announcements accepts court_price=32 and returns it; also works with court_price omitted (=null). Frontend E2E (Playwright, 390x844): login as marc → Profile shows 'Admin · Tarifs des clubs' → /admin-clubs lists 16 clubs, saved 35€/h on Casa Padel and value persisted. Reopened Casa Padel detail Info tab: 'Location du terrain' pricing table renders (1h=35€/8.75€ per player, 1h30=52.50/13.13, 2h=70/17.50). Opened Padel Attitude (price null) → info shows 'Tarif à confirmer'. Composer on Padel Attitude: 'Tarif terrain (€)' input (testID ann-court-price-input), entering 32 → 'Par joueur (÷4)' auto-displays 8.00 €. Posted announcement → pastille 'Terrain 32 € · 8.00 €/joueur' visible in feed. Julie: profile page does NOT show admin link, direct /admin-clubs shows 'Accès réservé aux administrateurs'.
action_items: Optional: Casa Padel's price is now 35€/h after test run (via admin UI). Reset to null via /admin-clubs → clear input → save if you want the clean 'Tarif à confirmer' default in Info tab.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py > admin_update_club: no upper bound validation on the input via ClubPriceUpdate is present besides ge=0/le=200. Good, but consider logging the admin action (audit trail).
server.py > on_startup: seed of REAL_CLUBS is idempotent by name (find_one by name) which is correct — running twice does not duplicate. Removal of OLD_DEMO_NAMES is one-shot and safe.

club/[id].tsx > post(): court_price validation is purely permissive (Number of string); non-numeric input (e.g. 'abc') will send NaN and be rejected by Pydantic (422). Consider guarding on the client to display an inline error. Currently silent failure (posting swallowed in catch).
admin-clubs.tsx > save(): value validation (isNaN || <0 || >200) silently returns without any user feedback. Consider a toast/inline error when invalid.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ announcements created during backend tests (posted to first club with content 'TEST_ann_price ...' and 'TEST_ann_no_price'); one TEST_compose_price_32 announcement posted on Padel Attitude via frontend. These do not affect functional flows but can be cleaned by main agent if desired. Casa Padel price left at 35€/h (was null) — see action_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working end-to-end. testIDs verified: admin-clubs-btn (profile), admin-club-{id}, admin-price-input-{id}, admin-save-{id}, admin-back, tab-info, tab-chat, ann-court-price-input, ann-content-input, ann-post-btn. Admin control point: ADMIN_EMAILS env var in backend/.env (currently marc@padel.fr). is_admin is derived on every /auth/me and never stored on the user document. price_per_hour bounds: 0..200 (server-enforced). court_price bounds: 0..500.
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature verification. All acceptance criteria from the review request met.
